tool_args.rationale: The observations show both relaxation from the current state and dependence on input, memory, and sink gradient. Fit the relaxation rate and source coefficients numerically, select among simple input and gradient transformations by leave-one-out error, and test on fresh confirmation. Confirmation performance is not yet known.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; the eight observations now permit fitting and comparing compact transient models.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane, Cobb–Douglas, and static barrier flux
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These recalled static laws omit the observed dependence on the current state and transient memory.
The available rows do not identify a more elaborate coupled system reliably; a relaxation model is a parsimonious approximation.
